name: firecrawl-rabbitmq
description: RabbitMQ is the message broker used by Firecrawl's NuQ job queue and worker services. Uses the official RabbitMQ Docker image with the management plugin. Configuration Management Port 15672 RabbitMQ management web interface. This port is exposed on the host for administration. AMQP Port 5672 Internal RabbitMQ connection port. Firecrawl connects to RabbitMQ through the firecrawl Docker network. No host port is required. Default credentials Username: guest Password: guest These credentials are used only on the local Firecrawl Docker network.
